title: Projektetage Uniform Morph Typography
description: Make projektetage intro title a bit smaller. Ensure all presentation morph element kinds (title, description, goal, authors, affiliations) use the same default text size across all slides.
summary:
Projektetage intro title and all morph elements now share one default size across slides.

- Added `--r-presentation-morph-size: 1.35em` (down from 1.6em h2 title scale) in presentation renderer globals.
- Introduced `presentation-morph-text` on all morph leaves (h1–h6, p, bullet lists, authors h4, affiliations h5) so title, description, goal, authors, and affiliations no longer diverge via reveal heading tiers (h2 vs h4 vs h5).
- Renderer test asserts every intro morph `data-id` leaf carries `presentation-morph-text`.
- All @framework/presentation/core (7) and renderer/react (7) tests pass.
